history.created_by: RUN |5 SOURCE_PACKAGE=libgit2 BASELINE_VERSION=0.28.4+dfsg.1-2ubuntu0.1 EXPECTED_VERSION=0.28.4+dfsg.1-2ubuntu0.1+getpatched1 APT_SOURCES_ BINARY_PACKAGES=libgit2-28 libgit2-dev /bin/sh -c set -eu;     mkdir -p /etc/ssl/certs;     cp /tmp/getpatched-runner-ca.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt;     chmod 0644 /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt;     printf 'Acquire::https::CAInfo "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99getpatched-ca;     test -n "$APT_SOURCES_B64";     printf '%s' "$APT_SOURCES_B64" | base64 -d > /etc/apt/sources.list;     apt-get update;     apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential python3 valgrind pkg-config;     apt-get -y dist-upgrade;     case "$SOURCE_PACKAGE" in       libxml2) binaries="libxml2 libxml2-utils" ;;       libarchive) binaries="libarchive13 libarchive-tools" ;;       libpng1.6) binaries="libpng16-16 libpng-dev libpng-tools" ;;       libgit2) binaries="libgit2-28 libgit2-dev" ;;       poppler) binaries="libpoppler97 libpoppler-dev libpoppler-private-dev libpoppler-glib8 libpoppler-glib-dev libpoppler-glib-doc gir1.2-poppler-0.18 libpoppler-qt5-1 libpoppler-qt5-dev libpoppler-cpp0v5 libpoppler-cpp-dev poppler-utils" ;;       tiff) binaries="libtiff-tools" ;;       *) echo "Unsupported source package" >&2; exit 1 ;;     esac;     for binary in $binaries; do       candidate="$(apt-cache policy "$binary" | awk '/Candidate:/ {print $2}')";       test "$candidate" = "$BASELINE_VERSION" || { echo "Baseline candidate changed for $binary: $candidate" >&2; exit 1; };     done;     for binary in $binaries; do apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "$binary=$BASELINE_VERSION"; done # buildkit

RUN |5 SOURCE_PACKAGE=libgit2 BASELINE_VERSION=0.28.4+dfsg.1-2ubuntu0.1 EXPECTED_VERSION=0.28.4+dfsg.1-2ubuntu0.1+getpatched1 APT_SOURCES_ BINARY_PACKAGES=libgit2-28 libgit2-dev /bin/sh -c set -eu;     test -n "$BINARY_PACKAGES";     packages="";     for binary in $BINARY_PACKAGES; do       package="$(find /tmp/getpatched -maxdepth 1 -name "${binary}_*.deb" -print -quit)";       test -n "$package";       packages="${packages}${packages:+ }$package";     done;     apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends $packages;     for binary in $BINARY_PACKAGES; do       test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' "$binary")" = "$EXPECTED_VERSION";     done;     rm -rf /tmp/getpatched /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit
